INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.

4. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.

7. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

8. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

9. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
